sources.title: Effect of physical therapy on pain and function in patients with hip osteoarthritis: a randomized clinical trial
sources.publicationStatus: Final journal publication, before access date.

access.details: Publisher HTML full text inspected; PubMed corroborated identifiers.

integrity.method: Publisher/PubMed and DOI correction/retraction query inspected.
integrity.result: Letters/reply surfaced, not a correction or retraction; no notice located.

sources.population: Radiographic symptomatic hip OA; pain ≥ 40/100 mm; community volunteers.
sources.coInterventions: Education, manual therapy, optional walking stick; home exercises.
sources.outcomes: At 13 weeks pain difference 6.9/100 mm (95% CI −3.9 to 17.7) favored sham nonsignificantly; function difference 1.4 (−3.8 to 6.5).
sources.harms: 26 mild/transient events in 19/46 active vs 9 in 7/49 sham; participant reporting.
sources.limitations: Not clinical approval or a universal ordinary-training restriction.

protocol.execution: Hip abductor/quadriceps strength, mobility, balance/gait; individualized variants.
protocol.dose: 4–6 home exercises; per-exercise dose not extracted.

sources.title: Exercise Therapy in Hip Osteoarthritis—a Randomized Controlled Trial
sources.publicationStatus: Final journal publication, before access date.

access.details: Primary full text inspected at linked archive/publisher; Europe PMC XML used where PMC HTML challenged.

integrity.method: Primary metadata and retrieved text inspected; regional update searches. Bounded check, not registry-wide clearance.
integrity.result: No notice identified in inspected text; no formal replacement established.

sources.design: RCT, three main arms; analyzed n=209.
sources.population: Hip OA with relatively preserved vitality; contralateral prostheses permitted.
sources.outcomes: 12-week SF-36 bodily-pain difference vs control 5.7/100 (0.4–11.1); WOMAC pain vs placebo 5.1 (0.7–9.4).
sources.followUp: Controlled comparison 12 weeks; later treatment unrestricted.
sources.uncertainty: Unblinded exercise, ceiling effects; materials support and author book royalties.
sources.harms: No withdrawal attributed to therapy adverse effects; not equivalent to no events.
sources.limitations: Not clinical approval or a universal ordinary-training restriction.

protocol.execution: Strength, proprioception, balance and flexibility bundle.
protocol.frequency: Group weekly plus home twice weekly for 12 weeks.
protocol.progression: not reported in extracted article protocol.

locations: Results > Tables 2–4; Footnotes > Conflict of interest

sources.title: Addition of aerobic physical activity to resistance exercise for hip osteoarthritis (PHOENIX): a randomised comparative effectiveness trial
sources.publicationStatus: Final journal publication, before access date.

access.details: PubMed abstract inspected; ScienceDirect full text 403. Protocol below separately retrieved.

integrity.method: Primary metadata and retrieved text inspected; regional update searches. Bounded check, not registry-wide clearance.
integrity.result: No notice identified in inspected text; no formal replacement established.

sources.coInterventions: Resistance exercise and physiotherapist contacts both groups.
sources.outcomes: Adding aerobic activity did not improve 3-month pain more: MD 0.3/10 (−0.3 to 0.8), function −0.9 (−3.6 to 1.8).
sources.uncertainty: No superiority is not proof of equivalence; NHMRC funding.
sources.harms: 24 related events combined vs 31 resistance-only; none serious (abstract); ascertainment unavailable.
sources.limitations: Not clinical approval or a universal ordinary-training restriction.

protocol.execution: 4–6 selected lower-limb exercises; bridge and sit-to-stand detailed in supplement.

protocol.stoppingRules: Discontinue as necessary after adverse event; arrange medical advice.

sources.title: Exercise for osteoarthritis of the hip
sources.publicationStatus: Final journal publication, before access date.

access.details: Current PubMed abstract inspected. Cochrane public webpage mixes updated summary with older 10-trial abstract; current PubMed version used.

integrity.method: Primary metadata and retrieved text inspected; regional update searches. Bounded check, not registry-wide clearance.
integrity.result: 2026 pub 3 is formal update of 2014 pub 2; not a retraction.

sources.design: Cochrane review; 18 RCTs/1368; search to 5 Feb 2025.
sources.population: Adult hip OA; excludes perioperative programs.
sources.comparator: Placebo; usual care/no treatment; matched cointerventions.
sources.outcomes: Vs usual care: pain −7.19/100 (−10.70 to −3.68), function −8.79 (−12.00 to −5.41); moderate certainty, probably small clinical impact.
sources.uncertainty: Small/unblinded studies; placebo comparison less certain.
sources.harms: Exercise vs usual care RR 2.95 (0.62–13.96), very low certainty.
sources.limitations: Not clinical approval or a universal ordinary-training restriction.
locations: Abstract > Search methods; Synthesis of results; Conclusions

gaps: All material is draft and clinically unreviewed; no runtime mapping, supported-condition claim, default dose or escalation clearance follows.
No universal numeric load/range cap or hard exercise contraindication was established; benefit from alternatives and trial exclusions do not prove harm.
Concurrent condition restrictions, equipment requirements and independent joint limits remain controlling; stretching never earns strength-set credit or generic five-second progression.
Exact clinically acceptable pain response/ROM and load starting points remain individual; severe surgical-indication OA needs separate applicability review.
PHOENIX final full text inaccessible; its protocol cannot prove implemented adherence or final deviations.
